title: gouldia elongata var. kahili
intro:
Gouldia elongata var. kahili, commonly known as Kahili Ginger, is a plant species that belongs to the Zingiberaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving nausea. The therapeutic actions of Kahili Ginger include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and anxiolytic, providing relief from anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gingerols and shogaols, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
